title: Zesty Russian Noodle Tagine
description: A rich and comforting Russian dish with a Mediterranean twist, featuring custard powder and a cheese-pull finish, perfect for a sick day. It is cooked to an al-dente finish in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions until they are al-dente, then set aside.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat and cook the diced chicken breast until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the custard powder, paprika, and chopped fresh parsley to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large ceramic tagine, combine the cooked noodles, chicken mixture, grated cheddar cheese, and sour cream.
Mix well to combine and transfer the tagine to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
